text: These are the 5 reasons why Apple is having its worst month since the 2008 financial crisis — and one reason you can still be bullish (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Nov 27, 2018, 4:00 pm 34 pts Apple stock is on pace to have its worst month since 2008, dropping 21% and wiping out over $200 billion in value.
